summary: Support pre-0.20.30 adoption plan helpers and Wellman profile scaffolds

delivery.outcome: Allow --standard-adoption-plan ticket allocation on genuine pre-0.20.30 adopters via verified immutable-source helper fallback, and allow --migrate-wellman-scaffold for the closed set of canonical minimal Wellman profile scaffolds.
nonGoals: Do not weaken broken managedFiles digest closure checks on damaged target repositories.
Do not admit custom, native, or arbitrary profile IDs in --migrate-wellman-scaffold.

architecture.decision: Extend verify_allocation_plan in scripts/create_adoption_lock.py to bind the full allocator helper closure in standard_root to git_bytes(standard_root, revision, ...) and non-symlink checks, fall back to $ALLOCATOR_PACKAGE_ROOT helpers in project/new-ticket.sh only after verify_standard_adoption succeeds under --standard-adoption-plan, and generalize validate_wellman_scaffold to accept the closed canonical WELLMAN_SCAFFOLD_PROFILES allowlist.
interfaceChanges: validate_wellman_scaffold accepts the closed set of canonical Wellman profile IDs in addition to profile:baseline.
architecture.rollback: Revert this bounded commit through the protected publication process.

validation.evidence: Pre-0.20.30 adoption plan fixture lacking local work_start_check.py and ticket_storage.py allocates cleanly via verified immutable source helpers while tampered source helpers or broken target locks fail closed.
Minimal canonical Wellman profile scaffolds (including profile:runtime-service) migrate cleanly while custom, native, and unknown profile IDs fail closed without writes.
Managed governance checks and Wellman v0.23.0 conformance checks pass with zero errors.
